articles.summary: ✅ A guide to integrating Keycloak in Nuxt.js. We compare nuxt-auth-utils and @sidebase/nuxt-auth, provide code examples, and explain the differences for SSR, hybrid, and static rendering to help you find the best authentication solution for your project.
articles.title: Nuxt & Keycloak: A Simple Guide to SSR Integration | BLUESHOE
